name: @rayu-dev/rayu-core
description: Shared engine core for Rayu: build configuration, portability shims, config, auth, tools, commands, context, MCP and the query engine — everything the CLI and the Rayucode VS Code extension both need, with no terminal UI. Consumed by rayu/ as a file: devDependency (Bun-bundled) and by the extension as an npm dependency. See RAYU_CORE_MIGRATION_PLAN.md.
//dependencies: zod is pinned to the SAME exact version as @rayu-dev/agent-protocol and the root `overrides`. A second zod instance makes `instanceof` and safeParse disagree across package boundaries — see PROTOCOL.md §5 and the migration plan's invariant 4. Core imports from the `zod/v4` subpath, as agent-protocol does.
//build: Cleans first. `files: ["dist"]` ships the whole directory, and tsc never removes output for deleted sources, so a renamed or reverted module would keep shipping a stale artifact. That happened: dist/portable/{semver,yaml}.js survived a reverted migration and still lazily required npm packages that core does not declare. test/npmConsumption.test.ts now catches it; cleaning prevents it.
